cases: 8-token prefill per session followed by seven decode calls, then prefill-only cases with a total of two rows (two tokens in one session, one token in each of two sessions). One warmup per round/case.
variants: Candidate and repeat use the default compiled dispatch. Reference and control substitute the base worker callback only for two-row forward calls. All modes share the remaining prefill, one-session decode and output head paths.
advance: Exact IDs, logits, KV and workspace per case. Both candidate labels must have median paired two-session decode ratio <=0.95, with at least three of four ratios <1. Guard median paired ratios <=1.05 for all prefill cases and single-session decode. A/A and B/B total decode and prefill median ratios must be in [0.95,1.05]. Retain all individual ratios and prior failed records.
